limitations: Development results are diagnostic, not fresh benchmark evidence.
Source variants and repetitions are correlated.
Provider costs exclude Codex session costs.
Local raw reports preserve recorded observations; LangSmith contains only successfully uploaded data. This evidence file retains summaries and failed cases.
Timeout and interrupted provider spans can lack cost receipts; reported costs sum available receipts and are not asserted to include unreported charges.
Provider timeouts establish execution failure, not a confirmed provider-wide outage. No subsequent passing complete development gate or fresh holdout evidence exists.
c8ced82b provider costs cannot be fully recovered from LangSmith because its traces were rejected. No zero-cost or complete-cost claim is made.
The latest local diagnostic scores are preserved separately from durable publication; prior local feedbackComplete fields are not sufficient evidence of successful uploads.
